messages:
jess: follow-up from INC-1234 postmortem  we promised concrete owners and timelines for rollout/canary fixes. here's a compact action list, please claim or flag blockers. link: <https://internal.redwood/postmortems/INC-1234>
kevin: I can own runtime auto-rollback for canaries (platform-level). estimate 2w. will scope to canary controller + healthhook integration. :+1:
maria: I'll take blast-radius guardrails on the feature-flag side. default conservative max_pct + admin approval flow for >0.5. estimate 3w.
samir: I'll own the follow-up tracker and pattern review. setting up a biweekly recurring board and linking regressed prompts. 1d to seed.
anya-sre: SRE will add an alert rule: sustained >3% 5m error rate during canary -> throttle webhook + ops runbook. 4d to ship.
deploy-bot: Canary healthhook check: 2 consecutive failures -> trigger rollback job and post to #eng-oncall.
kevin: question  should rollback thresholds be global or per-rollout? I prefer per-rollout config with platform defaults.
jess: agreed. platform default = auto-rollback at >3% 5m; rollout config may override. document schema change.
maria: API/console notes: new flag param `max_pct` (float). default 0.5. require org-admin approval for requests >0.5. show warning when >1%.
kevin: impl note: runtime needs a light circuit watching rolling error counters + KV for rollback state. patch path infra/canary/auto_rollback. PR by next Tue.
anya-sre: ops runbook snippet to add:
```
if canary_error_rate_5m > 0.03 for 2 windows:
  - pause ramp
  - trigger rollback job
  - notify #eng-oncall and #product
```
maria: SDK change: add `max_pct` param and client-side validation. ping @integrations for compatibility.
samir: tracker card RFU-457 created and linked to postmortem. tasks: analytics runbook, recurring review, follow-up sync. invite sent.
jess: timeline recap: kevin 2w / maria 3w / anya 4d / samir 1d. follow-up sync Fri 09:30 to update status. add risks to ticket (rollback thrash, canary state races). tagging @product :eyes:
